Hello Jose
,
Our colleague from the Austria region has raised a concern regarding the display of the charged energy value in ELMS. It appears that the value can no longer be shown with decimal places (e.g., 55080 Wh is now displayed as 55.080 kWh).
This poses a challenge for their customer, who requires the value to be displayed with three decimal places for energy reporting purposes.
Do you know if there is a way to convert this value back into Wh, or to configure the system to display it with the required precision?
Thank you in advance for your support.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0432832-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T2170004421]Energy Registers Switched from Wh (UINT) to kWh CRM:02681000381
additional_info.body:
Hello,
As you can see on The SichargeD Modbus Interface for EMLS (pdf file), all Energy values from Charger to EMLS are in [kW] and they have mostly a factor from 100. It is not possible to change this on the SichargeD. These factors are predefined constants.
It means for the UINT variable  (max value = 4.294.967.295):
The received value 5508000 must be transformed to REAL and then divided by 100. The result will be 55080.00 [kW]
This REAL value hast to be multiplied by 1000 to get units in [W]
This is the normal way to handle the value. In this moment, this value is “ready” to be displayed in an HMI or GUI.
In Other words. Only the control Unit (EMLS) in charge to do this reading and transforming from the SichargeD value is responsible to solve this issue.
If you have more questions or comments, please be free to send those to us.
With best regards,
